Ford Trucks International Voiceover

A soft-spoken voiceover for one of the biggest logistics manufacturers in the world

‹›

It's amazing how much good music elevates voiceover

Ford Trucks International got in touch and asked me to provide a soft, calm, reassuring voiceover for their new video. This video thanks all of the people around the world who are working through this crisis, providing necessary medical care, food, and support to keep the world moving. The video has a sweet message and I'm very pleased with my performance, but what struck me particularly with this commercial was that the music completely elevated my voiceover. And, I also think my voiceover elevated the music. When an ad like this works best, its audience feels something. I helped make this video and even I felt something when I watched the final cut. If you'd like to hear more like this, with a similar soft voiceover style, check out my Waitrose and Micropolitics videos

Ford Trucks International Voiceover

A little more about Ford Trucks International

This isn't actually the first time I've worked with Ford Trucks, so I was very glad that they wanted to work with me again. I'd previously provided voiceover for their F Max Campaign and I think it turned out pretty well. It's tricky to say a little more about one of the biggest automotive manufacturers in the world. Obviously, Ford make all kinds of vehicles, but this particular subsidiary of the company specialises in trucks used in the international logistics industry. Chances are you've seen thousands of Ford Trucks over the years and that much of your weekly shop and other essentials you need get to your local shops because of them!
